mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (role_id, email, password, nickname, description) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.role_id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user u WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT u.id, u.role_id, u.email, u.password, u.nickname, u.description, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user u WHERE u.email = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET role_id = #{roleId}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, nickname = #{nickname}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
